name: Regard
tagline: Proactive clinical AI that reads the whole chart before the visit.
description: Clinical insights platform that analyzes a patient's full chart — averaging tens of thousands of data points — before an encounter, then surfaces undiagnosed conditions, recommends diagnoses, and drafts near-complete documentation for physician review. Deployed across health systems including Cedars-Sinai, Banner Health, and UVA Health to reduce documentation burden and improve diagnosis capture.
insight: Cedars-Sinai is both an investor in and a clinical deployment site for Regard.
edge: Reads the full chart proactively before the visit — surfacing undiagnosed conditions and drafting the note, vs. ambient scribes that only capture the encounter.
